title: T1491 — Defacement
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Defacement with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.

steps.title: Recon
steps.caption: The attacker scans the public site and finds an outdated CMS with a vulnerable plugin. Defenders see: nothing yet. Scanning blends into normal internet noise, so there is no alert at this point
steps.defender: WAF, reverse-proxy and application logs record the request, payload and backend behavior.
